title: Sable: Weighted - Design n' Decor
description: Design n' Decor x Sable Physics Compatibility
body:
## 06/22 - i'm investigating the logging issue on world load with:
```
[Server thread/ERROR] [de.ry.sa.Sable/]: Failed to apply tag physics properties. Unknown block: <BlockID>
```
#### tl;dr - mod works, ignore "errors" (sorry for log spam)
### i'm not exactly sure why it's happening but outside of the log spam, the mod works as expected with no performance impacts, etc. i noticed that loading into any worlds where i previously was using any of my sable: weighted packs is spitting out errors related to blocks that would have otherwise been referenced. the good news is it's a one time thing per load and doesn't happen consecutively in single sessions.

---

Adds full block physics weighting for Create Deco when using the Sable physics system.

---

**Features**
- Complete coverage of Design n' Decor blocks
- Realistic mass scaling _on flooring materials only_
- Form-based weighting (bolts, chains, cogwheels, etc.)
- Adjusted volume for partial blocks (slabs, stairs)
- Lightweight handling for thin geometry (bars, ladders, mesh, windows)
- Consistent behavior across decorative and structural elements

---

**Installation:**
Simply place this mod jar inside your `mods` folder
